Definitions and release timing

Legacy, TFF and Disaggregated classifications describe different CFTC reporting schemes. Do not combine categories between them. Futures-only and futures-and-options combined reports are separate datasets. The position date is not the publication date; the API does not supply a per-row publication timestamp, so the interface leaves that field unknown and shows retrieval time separately. CFTC generally releases reports Friday at 3:30 p.m. Eastern using the preceding Tuesday’s positions; holiday schedules may shift release.

“Net % of OI” is calculated as (long − short) ÷ reported open interest × 100 only when all required values are present. Missing values remain missing, never zero. COT reports are delayed aggregate positioning and do not identify individual traders or explain their intent.
